name: Universal TV Tab-Index Fix
description: Adds tabindex to interactive elements that lack it so D-pad can reach them

params.code: var fixed = 0; document.querySelectorAll('[role="button"], [role="link"], [role="tab"], [role="menuitem"], [role="option"], [onclick], [class*="clickable"], [class*="Clickable"]').forEach(function(el) { if (!el.hasAttribute('tabindex') && el.tagName !== 'A' && el.tagName !== 'BUTTON' && el.tagName !== 'INPUT') { el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); fixed++; } }); document.querySelectorAll('[class*="card"], [class*="Card"], [class*="tile"], [class*="Tile"]').forEach(function(el) { var link = el.querySelector('a'); if (link && !el.hasAttribute('tabindex')) { el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); el.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Enter') link.click(); }); fixed++; } }); return 'fixed-' + fixed + '-elements';
